name: The Bombay Burmah Trading Corporation Limited
remarksWeb: 1. Pursuant to the effective implementation of the Composite Scheme of Arrangement among National Peroxide Limited, Naperol Investments Limited, and NPL Chemicals Limitedas sanctioned by the Hon'ble NCLT on May 4, 2023, the original Naperol Investments Limited (CIN: U65990MH1980PLC022589) has been amalgamated into National Peroxide Limited and ceases to exist. Consequently, its name has been removed from the Promoter category as per the FAQ dated 9th July, 2025 issued by NSE. Post-amalgamation, National Peroxide Limited has been renamed as Naperol Investments Limited (CIN: L66309MH1954PLC009254) and now holds 65,85,117 equity shares of the Corporation.   2. Further, in accordance with the Order dated November 25, 2024, issued by the Honble National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT), Macrofil Investments Limited (Macrofil) has been amalgamated with Nowrosjee Wadia & Sons Limited (NWS) under the approved Scheme of Amalgamation. Both Macrofil and NWS are part of the Promoters of the Corporation, and the related procedural formalities are currently in progress.The name of Macrofil Investments Limited is removed from Promoter category

name: Bombay Burmah Trading Corporation Limited
remarksWeb: Pursuant to the effectiveness of Composite Scheme of Arrangement amongst National Peroxide Limited and Naperol Investments Limited and NPL Chemicals Limited and their respective Shareholders and Creditors under Sections 230 to 232 and other applicable provisions of the Companies Act, 2013 and as per the NCLT order dated 4th May 2023, Naperol Investments Limited (Promoter) has been merged with National Peroxide Limited (Promoter) which is now known as Naperol Investments Limited due to change in the name. Naperol Investments Limited (Promoter) holds 65,85,117 shares under a new PAN as on 31st March 2025. Therefore, the Corporation has reported NIL shareholding against Naperol Investments Limited under old PAN in the Promoter Category.

name: Bombay Burmah Trading Corporation Limited
remarksWeb: Wallace Brothers Trading & Industrial Ltd(WBTIL) vide letter dated 26-07-23 submitted the Disclosures with the Corporation & Stock Exchanges under SEBI(SAST) Regulations, 2011 & SEBI(PIT) Regulations, 2015 wherein it has shown itself as the Promoter Group. On 26-09-23, 1000 Equity shares were sold through off-market transaction by Nowrosjee Wadia and Sons Ltd(NWS)(Promoter) to Ben Nevis Investments (Mauritius) Ltd (Holding Co. of NWS) & thereupon, it has become Promoter of the Corporation.
